summary: Birks Group Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the OTCQB, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 2, 2026, announcing the appointment of Davide Barberis Canonico as President and CEO effective October 30, 2026. Barberis Canonico had served as Interim President and COO since August 2025 and retains his board seat; Executive Chairman Niccolò Rossi di Montelera continues in that role. This is a routine, pre-planned management appointment rather than an abrupt departure, so it is not treated as a special situation.
